'''P6-K4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
P6-K4 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' as the Republic Flashpoint courier for the flashpoint "[[Korriban Incursion]]", though he is only found aboard Carrick Station and not on other planets like other couriers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''
